meta.note: Hand-resolved fallout from the GulfPub Iraq reconciliation's match failures. Memo: notes/escalation-2026-07-28-gulfpub-iraq-match-quality.md NOTE: the four OtherEnglishNames fills carry no [ref] cell by design — GGIT has no name-level ref column; sources are in ResearcherNotes.

resolutions.researcher_notes: GEM spells this field "Okaz"; the dominant English spelling is "Akkas", with "Akkaz" and "Akaz" also in independent use (Iraq Business News maintains both /tag/akkas/ and /tag/akkaz/; Power Technology profiles the offtaker as "Akaz Power Plant"). All refer to the same Anbar field (عكاز, discovered 1992, ~5.6 Tcf, near the Syrian border) feeding the Anbar combined-cycle plant via a ~250 km dry-gas line (SEPCOIII). Adding the variants to OtherEnglishNames. WHY THIS MATTERS BEYOND NAMING: the GulfPub reconciliation could not match its record "Akkas Gas Field (CPF) - Anbar CCP Plant" to these rows (no shared name token with "Okaz"), so it mis-matched to P7436/P7437 Artawi (Basra, ~500 km away) and surfaced as a false status conflict. Consider also normalising the primary name to "Akkas" — recommended, not applied. CITATION HOME: GGIT has no name-level [ref] column (the 22 ref columns are Status/Fuel/PipelineType/Background/Proposal/Construction/Start/Delay/Shelved/Cancelled/Stop/Capacity/Pressure/Length/Diameter/FuelSource/Location/ProjectLevelCost/SegmentCost/FID/Route/H2RepurposedKmOr%), so this value is staged with NO ref cell and the attestation belongs in ResearcherNotes: https://www.iraq-businessnews.com/2022/08/22/work-begins-on-akkas-gas-pipeline/ ; https://www.mees.com/2022/8/26/power-water/anbar-power-plants-to-build-case-for-akkas-gas/471db9c0-2532-11ed-9686-9f98e897bfab ; https://www.power-technology.com/marketdata/power-plant-profile-akaz-power-plant-iraq/ . All three pass url_verifier (HTTP 200 + term present).

resolutions.researcher_notes: MATCH CORRECTION, not a new finding. GulfPub record gulfpub:gas:105207 "Erbil - Dohuk Gas Pipeline" (status operating) was matched by the engine to P4047 Khormor-Erbil at composite 0.572 — the wrong row. GEM's actual Erbil-Duhok line is THIS row, P4053 (Status=construction). Re-attached by hand. GulfPub is a Tier-2 single source and never reaches green alone, but it independently corroborates the pre-existing country-note flag that P4053 should be operating. Route to Update for the 2-source test; do not flip on GulfPub alone. Also note the separate P4053 diameter conflict (OSM + vemak.com.tr give 36in vs GEM's "52in confirmed").
